overview: This file documents a two-year effort by the American Consulate at Dairen to obtain United States publications, zoning ordinances, city plans, and engineering maps for the Kwantung Government’s redevelopment of Dairen. Governor Takeshita sought American expertise as rapid population growth, construction of a civic center and railroad station, the transfer of the territorial government to Dairen, and plans for “Greater” Dairen created an urgent need for municipal planning. The correspondence traces cooperation among the State Department, Department of Commerce, Bureau of Standards, and National Resources Committee, culminating in the provision of planning literature and recommendations for obtaining maps and reports from several American cities.

subfiles.title: Grummon despatch requesting American city-planning assistance
subfiles.from: Stuart E. Grummon, American Consul at Dairen
subfiles.about: Grummon requests American planning and zoning publications to assist the Kwantung Government with Dairen’s rapid expansion.
subfiles.summary: Governor Takeshita sought U.S. help with town planning and zoning as Dairen approached 500,000 people and prepared to become the territorial capital; Grummon requests American reports, noting Sweden and Germany got similar requests.

subfiles.title: Grummon follow-up requesting two federal planning pamphlets
subfiles.from: Stuart E. Grummon, American Consul at Dairen
subfiles.about: Grummon asks that two readily available Department of Commerce pamphlets be sent while the broader collection of planning material is being assembled.
subfiles.summary: Grummon follows up requesting specific federal planning pamphlets on city planning and zoning ordinances, noting German and Swedish consuls already answered Kwantung's inquiries, urging prompt delivery.

subfiles.title: Zapf letter reporting referral to the Bureau of Standards
subfiles.to: Wilbur J. Carr, Assistant Secretary of State
subfiles.about: Zapf explains that the earlier consular despatch had not reached his section and reports forwarding it to the Bureau of Standards.
subfiles.summary: Zapf reports no prior record of Grummon's report, having forwarded it to the Bureau of Standards' Assistant Director for the requested information.

subfiles.title: Moser letter transmitting the Dairen request to McAllister
subfiles.from: C. K. Moser, Chief, Far Eastern Section, Division of Regional Information
subfiles.to: A. S. McAllister, Assistant Director, Bureau of Standards
subfiles.about: Moser formally sends the State Department’s original consular despatch to McAllister for consideration.
subfiles.summary: Moser, following a Stutman-McAllister call, sends the Dairen planning report to McAllister's committee, stressing the unique file copy must be returned.

subfiles.title: Zapf letter forwarding Bureau of Standards planning material
subfiles.to: Wilbur J. Carr, Assistant Secretary of State
subfiles.about: Zapf returns Grummon’s despatch and forwards the Bureau of Standards’ available planning material and procurement advice.
subfiles.summary: Zapf forwards McAllister's letter, Grummon's file copy, and Bureau of Standards material, noting older publications can be bought or sought from the National Resources Committee.

subfiles.title: State Department instruction transmitting planning literature to Dairen
subfiles.about: The State Department sends the interdepartmental correspondence and a substantial collection of American planning and zoning publications to Dairen.
subfiles.summary: The instruction responds to Grummon’s despatches of September 1935 and March 1936 by forwarding the Department of Commerce letters and their enclosures. It lists primers, model zoning and city-planning enabling acts, zoning guidance, and National Resources Board references on regional planning, courts, health, cooperation, and national and state planning.

subfiles.title: Grummon despatch requesting engineers’ zoning maps
subfiles.from: Stuart E. Grummon, American Consul at Dairen
subfiles.about: Grummon conveys a new Kwantung Government request for practical engineers’ maps of American cities with advanced zoning systems.
subfiles.summary: Grummon thanks the Department for planning literature and, with Kwantung preparing 'Greater Dairen,' asks for American engineers' zoning maps, suggesting municipal bodies, the PWA Housing Division, or the U.S. Housing Corporation.

subfiles.title: Delano letter recommending American city plans and zoning maps
subfiles.from: Frederic A. Delano, Vice-Chairman, National Resources Committee
subfiles.about: Delano supplies two planning publications and identifies American cities from which more detailed zoning maps and reports might be obtained.
subfiles.summary: Delano sends Memphis and Nashville zoning plans for Grummon, explains cheap-map limits, offers contacts for larger San Francisco/Akron/Dayton maps, and recommends New York, Cincinnati, and Springfield plans, praising Nashville's 1936 ordinance.

interest: Shows Dairen seeking American zoning expertise as it grew into Kwantung's planned territorial capital.
